items.description: We offer you to be in the role of air defense adjuster. You will have to shoot down enemy aerial targets that were launched from enemy rocket systems over your city. Air defense is a set of measures and weapons that help shoot down enemy planes, helicopters and rockets.The game is not simple. You must aim and shoot not at the missile, but at a point further along its tracking route. Air targets are usually very high. While your projectile will fly to intercept the enemy target, a certain amount of time will pass. During this time, the enemy will fly some more distance. You must fire at this distance for your projectile to collide with the enemy missile. Remember that your weapon reloads. This is not an machine gun that can fire bursts. Therefore, each shot must be clearly on target.To fight the enemy, you will have a normal projectile, as well as four additional types of weapons. You will be able to buy new weapons with coins that can be collected during the game. With in-game coins, you can also purchase powerful power-ups that will help you destroy the enemy.Achieve new records and get new ranks! There are 24 different ranks in the game (4 categories of 6). To set new records you need two things. First, play more often and practice your shooting skills. Second, accumulate money to play a round with a large supply of powerful bonuses.Forward to defend the airspace! items.description: Ancient Demon Shadow is a game that combines side-scrolling and exploration. In the battle between gods and demons 60,000 years ago, the world gathered top mages with the help of the Giant Modao clan to seal the Evil God King in Ancient Demon City. However, over the years, the population in Ancient Demon City has dwindled and the magic has weakened. The Evil God King has transformed his power into several major demons, seducing many government officials from different countries into soul trades to control them and break the seal of Ancient Demon City. Therefore, a mysterious hero has summoned players to eliminate him. Game Features: 1 Semi-Open World: Explore a semi-open world that includes various side-scrolling mechanisms. 2 Includes various hidden elements, hidden items that, when collected, can enhance character attributes. 3 Latest lighting and shadow rendering enhances the gaming experience. 4 Rich and colorful world, with a variety of ancient epic stories behind it. 5 A large number of high-quality music tracks, featuring various atmospheres and styles 6 After upgrading, you can master multiple magic spells, projectiles, transformations, and summoning of creatures. items.description: DESSTROKE is a demolition simulator that combines accurate demolition physics with freedom of action. You will have to make your neighbor angry by destroying every corner of his apartment.This game is an excellent anti-stress, where everyone gets an opportunity to make a little prank and smash everything around. Who could refuse such a thing? Also, after you make all your fruition a reality you'll have to get away with it...or just take it...You mistakenly walk into an apartment that isn't yours open wide and remember how you once worked at a house demolition job. But this time you decide not to demolish the whole house, but just one apartment. Of course, after all, behind the wall is yours!It will be especially interesting to draw on the walls and throw grenades, which you have in abundance. But be careful: the time until the arrival of law enforcement in the form of a robot is limited. Try to plan everything so that there is time to have fun and escape.Features :Realistic physics of destroying objectsRealistic explosion simulationStunning graphicsDestroying other people's property has never been more fun!
